summary: The Washington Post is an American daily newspaper founded on December 6, 1877. It is the largest newspaper published in Washington, D.C., with a particular emphasis on national politics. The note also gives its slogan, "Democracy Dies in Darkness," and says daily broadsheet editions are printed for the District of Columbia, Maryland, and Virginia.
one_line: The Washington Post is an American daily newspaper founded in 1877, the largest in Washington, D.C., with a focus on national politics.
key_facts: The Washington Post is an American daily newspaper.
The Washington Post was founded on December 6, 1877.
The Washington Post is the largest newspaper published in Washington, D.C., the capital city of the United States.
The Washington Post has a particular emphasis on national politics.
The slogan of The Washington Post is "Democracy Dies in Darkness."
Daily broadsheet editions of The Washington Post are printed for the District of Columbia, Maryland, and Virginia.
